params.name: scan_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the scan you want to enable or disable. This identifier can be either the `scans.schedule_uuid` or the `scans.id` attribute in the response message from the [GET /scans](ref:scans-list) endpoint. Tenable recommends that you use `scans.schedule_uuid`.

items.docs:
Enables or disables a scan schedule.
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role and Can Execute [32] scan permissions. See [Roles](doc:roles) and [Permissions](doc:permissions).

params.name: scan_id
params.description: The identifier for the scan you want to copy. This identifier can be either the `scans.schedule_uuid` or the `scans.id` attribute in the response message from the [GET /scans](ref:scans-list) endpoint. Tenable recommends that you use `scans.schedule_uuid`.

items.docs:
Copies the specified scan.
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role and Can Edit [64] scan permissions. See [Roles](doc:roles) and [Permissions](doc:permissions).

params.name: scan_id
params.description: The ID of the scan where the scan-specific credentials are currently stored.

params.name: credentials_id
params.description: The ID of the scan-specific credentials. For more information about determining this ID, see [Convert Scan-specific Credentials to Managed Credentials](doc:convert-scan-specific-credentials-to-managed-credentials).

items.docs:
Converts scan-specific credentials to managed credentials. For more information, see [Convert Scan-specific Credentials to Managed Credentials](doc:convert-scan-specific-credentials-to-managed-credentials).
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role and Can Edit [64] scan permissions. See [Roles](doc:roles) and [Permissions](doc:permissions).

params.name: include_aggregate
params.description: Specifies whether to include the imported scan data in the vulnerabilities dashboard views. To include, use `1`. To exclude, use `0`. If you don't specify the include_aggregate parameter, the data does not appear in the dashboard.

items.docs:
Import an existing scan that was previously uploaded using the [POST /file/upload](ref:file-upload) endpoint. Tenable Vulnerability Management supports scan imports up to 4 GB in size. **Note:** You cannot import results from scans run more than 15 months ago.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: active
params.description: If `true`, only active scans are counted. If `false`, all active and inactive scans are counted. If this parameter is omitted, Tenable Vulnerability Management defaults to `false`.

items.docs:
Returns the total number of scans in your container. You can use the `active` query parameter to return only the number of active scans.
Requires the Basic [16] user role and Can View [16] scan permissions. See [Roles](doc:roles) and [Permissions](doc:permissions).

Returns the timezones list for creating a recurring scan. For more information, see [Example Assessment Scan: Recurring](doc:example-assessment-scan-recurring).
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of missed targets returned in the response.

params.name: matched_resource_limit
params.description: Limit the number of matched resource UUIDs returned in the response.

items.docs:
Evaluates a list of targets and/or tags against the scan route configuration of scanner groups. Returns the list of missed targets (if any) and the list of matched scanner groups (if any).
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role. See [Roles](doc:roles).
